approval_ref: Reference Trunk Tools and let users ask questions answered from the existing project files.
notes: Reuse the existing selected-run project-question flow and exact inline citations; do not add a second chat service, vector database or external web-answer path.
Reproduce an Email sender address recombined from cited From and To addresses before changing the shared answer validator.
Keep each explicit email address atomic, preserve the local part, normalize only domain case, and keep bounded From/To/Cc/Bcc/Reply-To roles paired with the same address.
Keep an address with the exact RFI/Submittal context and source finding that supports it.
Validate Paragraph-locator retrieval under candidate pressure while preserving the existing bounded project/run evidence scope.
title: Ground project-answer email addresses
objective: Preserve explicit Email addresses, header roles, workflow scope and source-finding scope in answers grounded only in the selected analysis run's existing files.
